context_requirements: Cell must express functional SSTR1/2/3/5 (or OPRM1/OPRD1) at sufficient density to transduce Gi-mediated signaling.
Cell must have a somatostatin-responsive transcriptional program; most immortalized lines lack this.
Neuroendocrine or pituitary-derived lineage is typical for a measurable response.
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines.
Consistent downregulation of proliferation genes across multiple lines at 24 h.
Upregulation of immediate-early genes (FOS, JUN, EGR1) at 6 h.

evidence.supports: Somatostatin receptor agonists octreotide and pasireotide inhibit mitotic activity in rat anterior pituitary but have no effect on baseline turnover or apoptosis, indicating a narrow, tissue-specific antiproliferative action.
